note: Shared vocabulary for the Research Commons. Everything here is safe to publish. Subject ids are the Unanswered Archive's, so a question means the same thing in both places.

types.label: Research question
types.purpose: A question you think deserves investigation. The more specific it is, the easier it is to investigate.

types.label: Publication recommendation
types.purpose: A scholarly source you think belongs in the research conversation: a paper, book, preprint, essay, report or historical document.

types.label: Research topic proposal
types.purpose: A broader subject you think is worth exploring, with a short account of why.

types.label: Philosophical perspective
types.purpose: A brief, original, reasoned view on a question this site explores. It is an argument, not a finding.

categories.label: Human–Machine Relationships
categories.note: Added for the Commons. The Unanswered Archive's form does not offer it, and a backend must accept it for contributions.

lifecycle.label: Submitted
lifecycle.meaning: Received by the service. Nothing has been read yet.

lifecycle.label: Needs clarification
lifecycle.meaning: An editor needs more information before deciding.

lifecycle.label: Accepted for consideration
lifecycle.meaning: Judged suitable to consider. This is not approval to publish.

lifecycle.label: Approved for public display
lifecycle.meaning: An editor approved this exact text for the public library.

lifecycle.label: Declined
lifecycle.meaning: Not taken further. Never shown publicly.

lifecycle.label: Withdrawn
lifecycle.meaning: Removed from public view, at the contributor's request or for a stated reason.

publicStatuses.label: Approved for display
publicStatuses.meaning: An editor approved this text for the library. It has not been answered, investigated or endorsed by Artificially Intelligent.

publicStatuses.label: Selected for further investigation
publicStatuses.meaning: An editor chose to look into this. Selection is not an answer.

publicStatuses.label: Incorporated into other research
publicStatuses.meaning: An editor used this in another feature of the site, named in the record.

publicStatuses.label: Withdrawn
publicStatuses.meaning: No longer shown. Only a short notice remains.

attributionModes.label: A name of the contributor's choice
attributionModes.meaning: The name the contributor chose is shown. It is not verified, and it need not be a real name.

relationKinds.label: Editorial relationship
relationKinds.meaning: Set by an editor who read both records.

relationKinds.label: Automated suggestion
relationKinds.meaning: Proposed from shared words or tags. No one has reviewed it, and it does not show the two are related in substance.

relationKinds.label: Preliminary link
relationKinds.meaning: Assigned from titles and metadata by an automated process, not from reading the work.

relationKinds.label: Verified metadata
relationKinds.meaning: Matches a bibliographic record, not a reading of the work.

sourceVerification.label: Recommended by a visitor. Not verified.
sourceVerification.meaning: The details are as the visitor wrote them. No one has checked them.

sourceVerification.label: Bibliographic details match a record
sourceVerification.meaning: The title, authors and year match a bibliographic record. The work has not been read for this site, and it is not thereby credible or peer reviewed.

sourceVerification.label: Reviewed by an editor for relevance
sourceVerification.meaning: An editor judged it relevant to a topic here. This is not peer review and not an endorsement of its claims.

voices.visitor: Visitor contribution. It is not original research from Artificially Intelligent, it is not peer reviewed, and it is not evidence.
